 **Data Engineer**

You think in terms of data models, business domains, and consumption patterns, but you're equally comfortable working close to the infrastructure your data pipelines run on. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field.

 Hands\-on experience building and maintaining dbt projects in a data warehouse (preferably Snowflake).

 Solid understanding of dimensional modeling (star schema, preventing schema drift, etc. ) and the ability to design models that balance clarity, performance, and flexibility.

 Hands\-on experience with core AWS services (e.g., S3, Lambda, IAM).

 Advanced SQL — complex transformations, window functions, etc.

 Comfort exploring raw data, identifying quality issues, communicating findings clearly.

 You treat data code like software — version\-controlled, peer\-reviewed, tested, documented.

* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) to accelerate engineering workflows.

* Exposure to a workflow orchestrator (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect) — not required day\-to\-day, but a plus.
* Familiarity with dbt Mesh concepts (cross\-project references, data contracts) or multi\-project dbt architectures.

* Familiarity with BI tooling (e.g., Tableau, Looker) and how data models serve visualization layers.
* Exposure to data cataloging/discovery tools (e.g., DataHub).
* Any exposure to containerized deployments (Docker, SPCS) — not required, but a plus if present.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Position Name FIS Quantum Implementation Specialist \- Senior**
**Position Details**
**Program Leadership \& Client Advisory**
* Lead or co lead multi workstream Quantum implementations—from scope \& design through build, test, go live and stabilization—serving as the day to day advisor to Treasury, Finance, and IT stakeholders.
* Translate complex treasury requirements (FX, MM, IRD, commodities, cash pooling/IHB, netting, payments, hedge accounting) into scalable Quantum designs and roadmaps.
* Run solution design workshops; produce blueprints, specifications, data models and test strategies; manage risks, issues, and CCB.


**Configuration \& Build**
* Configure core Quantum modules (Deal Capture, Cash/Liquidity, Payments, Confirmations, Accounting, Risk, Reporting) and workflow (EWF), including controls and auditability.
* Design/optimize interfaces with ERPs (SAP/Oracle), bank connectivity, market data, and downstream reporting (BI/DWH).
* Create/optimize SQL, reports, and customizations as needed; contribute to performance tuning and environment readiness.


**Testing, Cutover \& Hypercare**
* Own SIT/UAT planning and execution; write test plans/cases; coordinate defect triage; orchestrate cutover run books and post go live support.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls and SOX requirements in design, testing, and change management.


**Optimization \& Health Checks**
* Assess existing Quantum estates to identify quick wins, release adoption and medium term enhancements (APIs, oData, EWF, dashboards, data lakes/BI, AI adjacent use cases).


**People \& Practice**
* Mentor junior consultants; contribute to accelerators, templates and best practices; support pre sales (demos, effort estimates).


**Qualifications**
**Requirements (including experience, skills and additional qualifications)**
* A bachelor’s degree (BE/BTech/MCA \& MBA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Accounting, Finance or a related field with adequate industry experience.


**Technical skills requirements:**
* 5–8\+ years in TMS delivery with hands on FIS Quantum across at least two full lifecycle implementations.
* Strong treasury domain: cash \& liquidity, IHB/pooling, payments \& connectivity, FX/IR/commodity risk, hedge accounting, accounting integration.
* Tech depth: SQL and data model familiarity; integration patterns with ERPs/banks/MDPs; Quantum EWF, interfaces, custom reports.
* Proven client facing consulting skills (workshops, requirements, solution options, stakeholder mgmt. up to CFO/Treasurer).
* Willingness to travel 25–50% based on project needs.


**Additional skills requirements:**
* The expectations are that a Senior will be able to maintain long\-term client relationships and network and cultivate business development opportunities
* Provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing engagement manager of engagement status, and managing staff performance.
* Must have presentation skills ' ability to create PowerPoint deck to communicate solution architecture to various stakeholders.
* Should have understanding and experience of L1 and L2 Support.
* Excellent business communication, Consulting, Quality process skills
* Must be a team player


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
